pages.quiz:
AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What should you do after mopping a floor? (1 mark)
   A. Sweep it
   B. Pour more water
   C. Run on it
   D. Put up a sign that the floor is wet

2. Which fuel comes in a metal cylinder? (1 mark)
   A. Dung cakes
   B. Firewood
   C. Gas
   D. Charcoal

3. What is pruning? (1 mark)
   A. Planting a seed
   B. Harvesting fruit
   C. Watering the plant
   D. Cutting off dead, weak or unwanted branches

4. Which PPE protects the body and clothes from dirt? (1 mark)
   A. Canvas shoes
   B. Dust mask
   C. Overall
   D. Gloves

5. Which is a woody tree fruit in this lesson? (1 mark)
   A. Kiwi
   B. Grapes
   C. Raspberry
   D. Tree tomato

6. Why might wet PPE stored away cause a problem? (1 mark)
   A. It becomes lighter
   B. It becomes cleaner
   C. It grows mould and smells
   D. It becomes stronger

7. Why should food be covered in the kitchen? (1 mark)
   A. To keep off flies, rats and cockroaches
   B. To keep it hot forever
   C. To hide the plate
   D. To make it heavier

8. Why should you never mix cleaning chemicals? (1 mark)
   A. They can give off harmful fumes
   B. They become soap
   C. They will cost more
   D. They will look nicer

9. Which tool is used to make the soil fine and level? (1 mark)
   A. Rake
   B. Spade only for cutting trees
   C. Hammer
   D. Panga

10. What is drip irrigation? (1 mark)
   A. Letting water fall slowly drop by drop near the roots
   B. Flooding the whole field
   C. Spraying water high into the air
   D. Throwing water from a bucket quickly

11. What do you use to scrub gumboots? (1 mark)
   A. A heavy stone
   B. A soft brush with soapy water
   C. A hammer
   D. A knife

12. Which of these is a part of a simple drip system? (1 mark)
   A. A scarecrow
   B. A compost heap
   C. A tractor
   D. A container for water

13. What do flowers become in a fruit tree? (1 mark)
   A. Trunks
   B. Roots
   C. Soil
   D. Fruits

14. Where is a scarecrow best placed? (1 mark)
   A. In the middle or at the side of the crop where animals come from
   B. At the river
   C. Far from the crop
   D. Inside the house

15. Which of these is another tacking stitch? (1 mark)
   A. French knot
   B. Herringbone
   C. Blanket stitch
   D. Long and short tacking

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Write a plan for growing a passion fruit plant from planting to harvest. (5 marks)

17. Describe how to build a compost heap using layers. (4 marks)

18. Give two advantages of direct sowing. (2 marks)

19. Why should tiny seeds be sown shallowly? (2 marks)

20. Give two advantages of boiling food. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Put up a sign that the floor is wet
   Wet floors are slippery.

2. C — Gas
   LPG gas is stored under pressure in a cylinder.

3. D — Cutting off dead, weak or unwanted branches
   Pruning helps light and air reach the plant.

4. C — Overall
   An overall covers the body.

5. D — Tree tomato
   Tree tomato and guava are woody.

6. C — It grows mould and smells
   Moulds grow in damp places.

7. A — To keep off flies, rats and cockroaches
   Covered food is protected.

8. A — They can give off harmful fumes
   Mixing chemicals is dangerous.

9. A — Rake
   A rake breaks lumps and levels the bed.

10. A — Letting water fall slowly drop by drop near the roots
   Drip irrigation gives small amounts of water directly at the roots.

11. B — A soft brush with soapy water
   A soft brush avoids damage.

12. D — A container for water
   A container holds water for the pipe or bottle.

13. D — Fruits
   Fruits develop from flowers.

14. A — In the middle or at the side of the crop where animals come from
   It must be seen by the animals that come to the crop.

15. D — Long and short tacking
   Long and short tacking is another type.

SECTION B
----
16. (5 marks)
   Answer: Build a trellis; dig and prepare a hole with compost; plant a seedling; water and mulch; tie the stem to the support; weed and prune; harvest ripe fruits and wash before eating.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct stage, up to 5.

17. (4 marks)
   Answer: Choose a shady place; lay sticks; add a dry layer, a green layer and dung; sprinkle soil and water; repeat to chest height; cover the heap.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for place, base and layers, soil and water, and covering.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: Roots are not disturbed, no nursery is needed, saves time and work (any two).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each advantage.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: They have little stored food so they cannot push up through deep soil.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for little food, 1 mark for not reaching the surface.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: It needs no oil and it makes hard food soft and safe.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each advantage.
